config.SprinklersFillPetBowl.name: Sprinklers fill the pet bowl
config.SprinklersFillPetBowl.tooltip: Each morning, a sprinkler that reaches the pet bowl's water fills it. In co-op, the host's setting applies.
config.SprinklersWaterGardenPots.name: Sprinklers water garden pots
config.SprinklersWaterGardenPots.tooltip: Each morning, sprinklers water the garden pots in their range. In co-op, the host's setting applies.
config.ConfirmWarpTotems.name: Confirm warp totems
config.ConfirmWarpTotems.tooltip: Ask before a warp totem sends you away.
config.ConfirmReturnScepter.name: Confirm Return Scepter
config.ConfirmReturnScepter.tooltip: Ask before the Return Scepter sends you home.
config.DecoratingTimeFreeze.name: Time freeze while decorating
config.DecoratingTimeFreeze.tooltip: Stop the clock inside the farmhouse or a cabin. In co-op, the host's setting applies and every player must qualify.
decorFreeze.started: Time stands still while you decorate.
config.WeddingReminder.name: Wedding reminder
config.WeddingReminder.tooltip: Get a letter on the day before your wedding.
config.WoodShelterStorage.name: Log pile storage
config.WoodShelterStorage.tooltip: The log pile beside the farmhouse door stores Wood and Hardwood, shared by all players.
woodShelter.inUse: Someone else is using the log pile.
config.StackUnusedTackle.name: Stack unused tackle
config.StackUnusedTackle.tooltip: Unused fishing tackle stacks in your backpack and chests. Worn tackle doesn't. In co-op, every player should use the same setting.
config.FastTitleScreen.name: Fast title screen
config.FastTitleScreen.tooltip: Skip the intro, show the title buttons at once, and shorten the fade after picking a save.
config.TitleSlideMilliseconds.name: Title slide duration
config.TitleSlideMilliseconds.tooltip: How long the slide to New, Load and Co-op takes. Vanilla's gets slower the wider your screen.
config.TitleUiScale.name: Title screen UI scale
config.TitleUiScale.tooltip: The UI scale used on the title, load, co-op and character creation menus. The game always uses 100% there.
config.ExtendedScaleRanges.name: Larger UI scale and zoom
config.ExtendedScaleRanges.tooltip: In the game options, allow UI scales up to what still fits your screen, and zoom up to 250%.
config.KeyboardMenus.name: Keyboard menu controls
config.KeyboardMenus.tooltip: Arrow keys move through menus, Enter or Space clicks, Backspace right-clicks, number keys answer questions, and Escape goes back on the title screen.
config.FadeSpeed.name: Location fade speed
config.FadeSpeed.tooltip: How fast the screen fades to and from black when you walk between locations. Sleeping and cutscenes are not affected.
config.CraftWithShelterWood.name: Craft with log pile wood
config.CraftWithShelterWood.tooltip: When crafting on the farm or in a farmhouse, Wood and Hardwood in the log pile count as ingredients.
config.NoEatPromptOnCrops.name: No "Eat?" on crops
config.NoEatPromptOnCrops.tooltip: Don't offer to eat the food in your hand when you click a crop or forage, for example an unripe crop.
config.NoGiftsThroughDoors.name: No gifts through doors
config.NoGiftsThroughDoors.tooltip: When you open a door while holding an item, don't hand it to a villager standing just below the door.
config.RangePreview.name: Range preview
config.RangePreview.tooltip: Show the area a sprinkler, scarecrow, bee house or Junimo hut covers while you hold or place one, or point at one.
config.BuildWithShelterWood.name: Build with log pile wood
config.BuildWithShelterWood.tooltip: Robin's buildings and house upgrades can use the Wood and Hardwood in the log pile.
config.PlayerBirthday.name: Your birthday
config.PlayerBirthday.tooltip: Mayor Lewis asks for your birthday. On the day, villagers wish you a happy birthday and friends send letters.
birthday.askSeason: Which season is your birthday in?
birthday.confirm: Your birthday is {{season}} {{day}}. Is that right?
birthday.saved: Lewis has added your birthday to the calendar.
birthday.spouse: Happy birthday, @! I wanted to be the first to say it.$h
